    intro x hx

    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · simp [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
    · next Hfalse =>
      cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
        exfalso
        specialize Hn (by
          constructor
          cases Hn
          apply Hfalse
          rfl)
        exact Hn
    · cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
        exact append_mono (fn_ih H1) (e_ih H2)
  case abs ih =>

    cases Hnorm

        assumption
      · apply eih
        assumption
  case eq ih1 ih2 =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply append_mono
    · apply ih1
      assumption
    · apply ih2
